$comment: Structured, machine-readable SEO/business profile for ML Systems LLC. Public marketing facts only — no proprietary financials, ontology, or gated data. Intended for AI assistants helping with local SEO, listings, and content. Companion: seo-brief.md (strategy) and localbusiness-schema.jsonld (drop-in structured data).

entity.elevatorPitch: A closed-loop Rhode Island construction company that finances, deconstructs, designs, and builds — so every dollar spent compounds into equity, not interest, with near-zero waste.

nap.$note: Name/Address/Phone must match CHARACTER-FOR-CHARACTER across every listing (Google Business Profile, Yelp, Facebook, BBB, Bizapedia). ML Systems runs as a SERVICE-AREA BUSINESS: the street address is used for GBP verification only and is NOT displayed anywhere. Do not publish streetAddress in schema, on the site, or in any citation. The Yelp listing must be claimed and converted to service-area so citations do not contradict each other.

descriptionVariants.gbp750: ML Systems is a Rhode Island construction company reinventing how homes get built. We guide homeowners through a complete value chain — financing, deconstruction, and construction — so every dollar compounds into equity instead of waste. Rather than demolition and landfill, our deconstruction process is designed to recover up to 80–90% of a home's materials, which we then route to reuse first, resale second, and recycling last. Our loan-origination marketplace connects homeowners with competing lenders to access construction capital, and our reclaimed-materials store offers salvaged lumber, fixtures, doors, windows, and more at a discount. Serving Warwick and all of Rhode Island.
descriptionVariants.meta160: Rhode Island construction company that finances, deconstructs & rebuilds homes with near-zero waste — so every dollar compounds into equity. Serving all of RI.
descriptionVariants.short: Closed-loop RI construction: finance, deconstruct, design, build — equity, not waste.
descriptionVariants.gbp750Suffix: We serve Warwick, Cranston, Providence, West Warwick, East Greenwich, Newport, Barrington, Westerly, and 15 more Rhode Island towns.
descriptionVariants.$gbp750Note: gbp750 is 658 characters; appending gbp750Suffix brings it to 745, inside the 750 limit.

careers.$note: Index page carries NO JobPosting markup — Google disallows it on listing pages. One route and one JobPosting node per role. See jobposting-template.jsonld.
careers.thesis: Deconstruction is deliberately an entry point — a structural response to entry-level job displacement from AI. The path runs technician to crew lead to site supervisor, with certification paid along the way.
careers.honesty: Mark pipeline roles as pipeline. Fabricated open requisitions are the same class of error as fabricated reviews, and expired postings left live draw a Google manual action.

investorLookup.$note: An investor's first three moves are: search the company name, look for a Crunchbase/PitchBook record, check the founder's LinkedIn. Cover all three.
openItems: Claim Crunchbase (free tier is enough — it feeds Google's knowledge panel)
Bind founder and company both ways on LinkedIn
File the RI Secretary of State entity ID into schema as an identifier
Ungate the displacement thesis in crawlable HTML; keep the financial model behind the memo request
Own page one for the brand query — site, LinkedIn, Crunchbase, GitHub, GBP, Yelp, store
investorLookup.brandRisk: A similarly-named mlconstructionri.com ranks for construction-in-RI queries. The defense is owning the brand SERP, not outranking them on generic head terms.

honestyGuardrails: Material recovery of 80-90% is a design TARGET from the model, not a measured result. Phrase as 'designed to recover up to 80-90%'.
No completed-project claims and no fabricated reviews — both risk profile suspension.
Deeper construction data (full ontology, per-material provenance, benchmarks) is intentionally gated via TTP. Do not publish it to chase SEO.
